dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000ssxt](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000ssxt) Magnitude 5.9 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Apr 26 2026 74km W of Darvi. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 46.7887 longitude 92.9681. It impacted 3984 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
